name: Shaw's Report
summary: In Westfall, Shaw's Report carries SI:7 intelligence to Gryan Stoutmantle. Written by Master Mathias Shaw, it tells of the Stonemasons Guild, Edwin VanCleef, and their grievance with the crown after Stormwind was rebuilt.

sections.title: Intelligence on the Stonemasons
sections.body:
Shaw's Report reaches Sentinel Hill from SI:7's covert headquarters in Stormwind. It gives the People's Militia its first clear account of who leads the bandits ravaging Westfall. Edwin VanCleef once led the Stonemasons Guild, whose masons rebuilt Stormwind City after its destruction in the First War.

The crown and nobility refused to pay them fairly, and resentment took root. Shaw's intelligence links the displaced craftsmen to the uprising now seizing the kingdom's outer territories.

faq.answer: Shaw's Report is a sealed intelligence dossier that Master Mathias Shaw prepared for Gryan Stoutmantle. Shaw leads Stormwind's covert SI:7 agency, and the report contains the crown's intelligence on the Stonemasons Guild and Edwin VanCleef's history.

faq.q: What does the report reveal about Edwin VanCleef?
aliases: what does it say about vancleef
faq.answer: The report names Edwin VanCleef as the former head of the Stonemasons Guild. He oversaw Stormwind's reconstruction after the First War, then he and his artisans revolted after the kingdom's rulers denied them proper payment.

faq.q: Why does Gryan Stoutmantle need this report?
faq.answer: Gryan Stoutmantle needs the report because he leads the People's Militia against coordinated bandit raids in Westfall. With no regular kingdom troops to help, he relies on Mathias Shaw's intelligence to learn who directs the outlaws and what drives them.

faq.q: How does Stoutmantle react to the report?
faq.answer: The report leaves Gryan Stoutmantle deeply unsettled. He remembers Edwin VanCleef as an industrious, accomplished craftsman and struggles to believe such a respected builder turned villain without further proof.

angles.text: Shaw's Report shows how far Master Mathias Shaw's reach extends. He leads SI:7, Stormwind's espionage network.
The report lays bare Stormwind's internal rot. An unpaid debt to the kingdom's architects helped spark an insurrection that threatens the realm's farmlands.
